import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_dist = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Sort by age number for proper ordering
age_order = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AlterVHundSort'].first().sort_values().index
age_counts = [age_dist.get(age, 0) for age in age_order if age in age_dist.index]
age_labels = [age for age in age_order if age in age_dist.index]
colors = plt.cm.coolwarm(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_labels)))
ax2.bar(range(len(age_labels)), age_counts, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_labels)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = plt.cm.tab20(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=colors_gender)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Owner Age Groups
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
owner_age = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
# Sort by AlterV10Sort
owner_age_sorted = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang').agg({'AnzHunde': 'sum', 'AlterV10Sort': 'first'}).sort_values('AlterV10Sort')
sns.barplot(x=owner_age_sorted.index, y=owner_age_sorted['AnzHunde'], palette='mako', ax=ax5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Dog Ownership by Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=8)
ax5.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
plt.setp(ax5.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 6. Trend over years
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
ax6.plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax6.fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Registration Trend Over Years', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Dog Registration in Zurich', 
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
